Title information inferred from OPAC of Waseda University, April, 7, 2020. Wood block print. Oriented with north to the right. Relief shown pictorially. Cadastral map showing landowners. Original published in Genroku 9 i.e. 1696. Japanese. Includes distance chart and daily listing of events in Edo for 1861. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
